name: code2pia
description: Generate RAT and DPIA drafts directly from code.

scripts.scan:example: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js scan examples/sample-app --jurisdiction CL-LEY-21719 --json examples/report.json --markdown examples/pia.md
scripts.scan:sample:low: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js scan examples/low-app --jurisdiction CL-LEY-21719
scripts.scan:sample:medium: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js scan examples/medium-app --jurisdiction CL-LEY-21719
scripts.scan:sample:high: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js scan examples/high-app --jurisdiction CL-LEY-21719
scripts.scan:sample:evidence: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js scan examples/evidence-app --jurisdiction CL-LEY-21719 --privacy-file code2pia.privacy.yaml
scripts.scan:samples: npm run scan:sample:low && npm run scan:sample:medium && npm run scan:sample:high
